conflicts.permit: Elokence will in such case cease to process the concerned personal data and retain it for the appropriate duration.
conflicts.prohibit: Pursuant to the applicable data protection laws and regulations, you dispose of the following rights regarding processing of your personal data: right of access, right of data portability, right of correction, right to erasure, right to object to processing and right to limitation to processing.
conflicts.situation: When a user exercises their right to erasure for personal data that was previously shared with third parties.
conflicts.reason: The policy recognizes the right to erasure, but explicitly states that upon an erasure request for shared data, Elokence will retain the data rather than erase it.
